scope: Independent final code review plus read-only saved-evidence verification; no new full12 or module simulation executed by reviewer.

rowpair_code_assessment.compute: Two default48 eight-PE engines consume one shared weight array in lockstep. Group remains stable until enqueue; INIT consumes tagged bias next edge, then requests next group while MAC runs.
rowpair_code_assessment.tail: secondRow is latched per launch; second engine start gated, outputSecond never advances on single-row mode. Odd row98 never emits row99.
rowpair_code_assessment.queue: Two pair slots, four eight-lane bundles maximum. Single producer reserves by launch count<2. Row0 POP retains the pair slot; row1 POP retires it. Simultaneous enqueue/retire preserves count and distinct head/tail ownership.
rowpair_code_assessment.clear: Accepts only idle/count0; resets both engines on clearFire, writes all16384 weights, both64-value X buffers, and shared768-word bias SRAM; clearDone waits all controllers. Results/tags are explicitly zeroed. Read-only physical observer checks per-address zero writes and nonzero prestate in development.
rowpair_code_assessment.public_contract: Start and source writes require idle; active modifications assert. Prototype has no CPU/MMIO lifecycle or error-response ABI.

paired_nice_assessment.address: 33-bit request_end includes optional second-row1024 stride; row-aligned group offset and group+count<=32 enforce each row span. Prior independent210944-case algebra enumeration passed.
paired_nice_assessment.identity: bit30 marks exclusive pair route, old20/23/24 reject before side effects; bit11 row identity checked live and after capture; group tag preserved.
paired_nice_assessment.ownership: Stable eight-lane snapshot precedes later commit; first error aborts, POP cannot retry. Eight serial32-bit LSU writes wait each response; completion follows last response.

permanent_acc41_assessment.prefix_bound_proof: All65 prefixes and complete signed16/signed40 domain
permanent_acc41_assessment.generic48_contract: 600 consecutive products remain tested; fixed64 engine rejects40 elaboration

resolved_review_findings: Comparator now requires each layer totals/window/entireclear equal, preventing aggregate cancellation.
Fixed64 DotProductEngine rejects width40; valid default48/optional41 generated SV unchanged.
Pair route rejects old drain opcodes upfront to prevent partial row0 consumption.
Permanent accumulator runner copies and hashes TB before and after simulation.
Portable paired runner pins transitive core/config.v and refuses output-directory reuse.
known_limits: Frozen pair TB stores vector path in1024 bits; README requires <=128 ASCII bytes, tested106. Use a shorter vectors path for relocation.
Module timings exclude production CPU/LSU/fabric, source loading/clear as documented; they are not full-SoC speed measurements.
Paired engine uses serial NICE LSU; it is not an independent DMA master and introduces no new bus requester.
No synthesis, area, energy, STA or formal-clear qualification. Production clear policy REVIEW_PENDING and FIFO physical-zero UNPROVEN remain.
review_execution_notes: Old rowpair final rejected source SHA as designed; reviewer switched to matching final-numeric and root integrated-rowpair-replay, both independently native_exit=0/PASS. No old receipt was changed or hash check relaxed.
An early static reviewer fixture counted repeated capability checks outside instruction_ok. The reviewer narrowed only its own assertion scope; raw failure log preserved. Candidate RTL was unchanged.

relocated_verifier_code_review.path_hook: Final permanent rowpair verifier now accepts a pure resolve callback; default preserves local behavior. Source/input paths all go through callback before reading; exact SHA remains mandatory. No receipt/source rewrite.
relocated_verifier_code_review.mapping: Longest original prefix first, then exact provenance fallback. Both return only actual files whose resolved path remains inside archive. Unmapped references fail.
relocated_verifier_code_review.comparison: Only current verifier/result path fields normalized; source/numeric/work/firmware data remain exact.
relocated_verifier_code_review.no_mutation: No simulator/synthesis invoked; dont_write_bytecode is set before importing helpers; only new output receipt is written outside archive.
relocated_verifier_code_review.caveat: Frozen comparator may find SHA-pinned inherited loader in ancestor live repo before local fallback if archive extracted inside that repo. Independent /tmp extraction avoids this. Suggested asserting resolved inherited loader inside archive and documenting independent extraction location.
